item.title: The hardest test - Wales need reaction in South Africa
item.description:
The Hardest Test Awaits: Wales Face Daunting Challenge in South Africa

As the sun sets over the scenic coastline of Durban, the stage is set for the most intense and potentially defining fixture of the 2025-26 Nations Championship season. For the Welsh rugby team, the daunting task of facing world champions South Africa at Kings Park on Saturday is more than just a test of their mettle – it’s a litmus test of their progress under coach Steve Tandy.
